notes.title: Employee A demo v1.2.1 released!
notes.content:
The latest version of the Employee A demo is now available! Thanks to everyone who provided feedback on the demo's first build. Patch notes below!

Improvements


 Improved text in the prologue
 Added the ability to move from any primary map directly to any other primary map
 Added transitions when moving between maps
 Added more tutorial text explaining how to use the timeline
 Apartment background music now sounds better on more sound systems, especially those with subwoofers


Fixes


 Fixed an issue where it was possible to softlock the game by trying to examine the timeline after completing all timeline entries
 Fixed an issue where history was inaccessible during the prologue
 Fixed an issue where some non-functioning menu options were shown when accessing preferences from the main menu
 Fixed an issue where some text in the pause menu had insufficient contrast to meet W3C-AA accessibility guidelines
 Fixed an issue where Jim’s mouth disappeared during the second and third frame of his frustrated blinking animation

notes.title: AVAILABLE NOW: Employee A Demo!
notes.content:
Save yourself from a cutthroat company culture, abusive co-workers, and a bizarre murder charge in Employee A. Demo out now!

Employee A is a pixel art point-and-click adventure set in the heart of the modern-day high technology industry. Inspired by classic mystery game series like Ace Attorney and Zero Escape, Employee A will test your logic and deduction skills as you investigate. To escape conviction, you'll have to:


 Find clues to regain your memories and establish your alibi
 Break through the selfishness and indifference of your tech industry co-workers
 Desperately try to hold yourself together as the aftereffects of trauma bear down on you


It'll take everything you've got to save yourself from prison time and survive the sharp edges of the corporate world. Enjoy your time in sunny California!
